name: Mauricio Ramírez L.
headline: Senior .NET Developer | Azure & Microservices | C# | CI/CD | Distributed Systems
summary: Back-End Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience designing microservices and building scalable distributed systems in .NET/C#. Proven track record implementing RESTful APIs, deploying on Azure cloud, and streamlining CI/CD pipelines to accelerate releases, reduce defects, and improve system reliability across finance and retail domains.

bullets: Designed and developed 10+ scalable microservices in .NET Framework/Core for inventory forecasting systems processing millions of records daily, applying microservices architecture patterns.
Built and optimized RESTful APIs with improved error handling and caching, reducing average response time by 25–35%.
Implemented CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub Actions, decreasing deployment time by 40% and enabling multiple weekly releases with a >95% success rate.
Enforced code quality through SonarQube analysis and unit testing, reducing production defects by 30% and improving codebase maintainability.
Containerized services using Docker to standardize deployments and improve environment consistency across development and production.
Contributed to high-volume backend systems supporting global retail operations, enabling scalable inventory processing and data-driven decision-making.
Developed microservices in .NET and Java for financial transaction systems handling high-volume digital credit operations.
Designed asynchronous processing and integrations that improved system throughput by 30% and reduced latency in transaction flows.
Participated in system design reviews, applying fault-tolerant patterns that improved service resilience and reduced downtime.
Delivered backend services powering digital credit and mobile wallet platforms in production at scale.
Automated decision logic and business rules to eliminate operational bottlenecks, improving processing efficiency and consistency.
Developed backend APIs and web applications using .NET Core and SQL Server, improving data accessibility and business operations performance.
Optimized SQL queries and stored procedures, reducing reporting execution time by 30–40%.
Maintained and enhanced HR and finance systems, improving system reliability and reducing support incidents by 20%.
Collaborated with stakeholders to implement system improvements aligned with operational needs.
